description: This file defines a VectorService class that provides vector-based document search and retrieval functionalities. It includes methods for generating simple text embeddings, searching for similar documents, and retrieving context for API requests. Placeholder implementations suggest it is part of a larger system for information retrieval within documents.

classes.name: VectorService
classes.description: Service for vector-based document search and retrieval, including embedding generation and similarity search.

methods.name: bool generate_embeddings(self, document_id: UUID)
methods.description: Generates placeholder text embeddings for a document identified by UUID, updating the document storage.

methods.name: List[float] _create_simple_embedding(self, text: str)
methods.description: Creates a simple term frequency vector from text, limited to 32 dimensions, for similarity purposes.

methods.name: List[Tuple[Document,List[str],float]] search_similar(self, query: str, document_ids: Optional[List[UUID]] = None, limit: int = 5)
methods.description: Performs a placeholder similarity search over documents, combining text matching and cosine similarity of embeddings.

methods.name: float _cosine_similarity(self, vec1: List[float], vec2: List[float])
methods.description: Calculates cosine similarity between two numeric vectors.

methods.name: List[str] get_context_for_request(self, method: str, path: str, document_ids: List[UUID])
methods.description: Returns relevant document chunks based on an API request's method and path, for context extraction.

methods.name: int reindex_all_documents(self)
methods.description: Regenerates embeddings for all documents stored.
